title: Tori workspace settings
description: One project's editor overrides, at <workspace>/.tori/settings.json. This file holds nothing but the editor block; anything else in it is read by nothing.

editor.description: Editor behaviour. Every key is optional: an absent key is not an answer, so it falls through to the layer below rather than meaning false.

formatOnSave.description: Format on save. Runs the project's own Biome or Prettier before writing, and nothing at all in a project that has neither.

organizeImportsOnSave.description: Organize imports on save. Asks the language server to sort this file's imports and drop the unused ones, just before the formatter runs.

codeLens.description: Code lens. Draws the language server's reference and implementation counts above the lines they describe.

vimMode.description: Vim keybindings. Modal editing in the code editor, with a status line showing pending commands.

indentGuides.description: Indentation guides. Vertical guides at each indent level, the active one highlighted.

softWrap.description: Soft wrap long lines. The default for every buffer; the palette's toggle overrides it for one tab.

renderWhitespace.description: Show spaces and tabs. Draws them as dots and arrows.

scrollPastEnd.description: Scroll past the last line. Lets the last line scroll up to the top of the viewport.

bracketPairGuides.description: Bracket pair guide lines. Vertical connectors between a bracket pair's two lines.

minimap.description: Minimap. Document overview strip down the right edge.

stickyScroll.description: Sticky scroll. Pins the class and function headers of whatever is at the top of the screen over it. Needs a language whose grammar Tori parses.

wordCompletion.description: Word completion without a language server. Suggests words already in the buffer, only where no language server has claimed the file.

hotExit.description: Keep unsaved edits across a quit. Quitting stashes unsaved buffers and restores them next launch instead of asking you to discard them.

compactFolders.description: Compact single-child folders. A folder whose only child is another folder renders as one row rather than a staircase.

todoPatterns.description: TODO tags. Comma-separated tags the TODO panel searches for, matched case-sensitively so a marker is not confused with the word in prose.
